bundle_storage: New identity binds parent manifest and all original rows; store ID-aligned added columns only for LIRF departures in original parent bundle. Join inherited values exactly in memory; do not copy or mutate the parent features.
external_data_license: OpenStreetMap contributors ODbL-1.0; tagged parking documentation CC BY-SA 2.0.
geometry_policy: Reuse the supported LIRF parking-point audit. Explicit same-ref nodes take priority; approved way-only last nodes are flagged. Exact full refs only. Undirected taxiways/taxilanes/linked parking lead-ins; no runway traversal. Deterministic shortest path to any mapped access on recorded runway, smallest access/node ID on equal distance. Exclude remaining centroids. No threshold direction or actual clearance claim.
queue_active: A peer is active if offblock < anchor <= movement and its signed NM interval is >0 and <=21600 seconds, as in the frozen v7 context. Age is anchor minus peer offblock. These are retrospective supplied-clock occupancy proxies, not observed queue positions.
queue_anchor: Prefer supplied AOBT, then LOBT, when movement-minus-clock is 0..21600 seconds inclusive; otherwise movement minus 1200 seconds, matching frozen v7 anchor convention.
queue_overlap: Shared undirected edge length divided by focal full route length including snap; count only positive shared lengths. No learning or target labels enter path weights.
queue_peers: Other LIRF departures only; exclude the focal movement and every peer with the same nonmissing flight ID. Strictly earlier pushes or takeoffs only. Peer mapped routes use the focal snapshot to avoid comparing different graphs. Missing/unknown peer routes contribute nothing and no event is assigned an inferred route.
queue_service: Completed peer takeoffs in [anchor-window,anchor). Report count of positive-overlap peers and mean signed movement-minus-preferred-NM-clock only for finite proxies. Preserve extreme values in this completed-service channel.
snapshot_policy: Latest declared January/July snapshot no later than actual UTC movement date. OSM recorded states are not assertions about physical change dates. All shared features exclude December departures and labels.
